verdict.rationale: Qapita is a SaaS cap table and equity management platform, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions a sandbox, test environment, or developer API environment, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path. Equity modeling and scenario planning are related features, not an isolated sandbox, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
